body:
# Native Gateway: browser status/profiles blocked by listener ownership verification

## Environment

- Windows Companion: v2026.9.8-1, matching the latest official GitHub release checked today.
- Gateway CLI: v2026.9.9.
- Local Native Gateway using the packaged runtime.
- The paired Windows Node is connected and advertises browser capability and browser.proxy.

## Reproduction and observed result

The main agent used the official browser tool to request status and profiles on the connected Windows Node. Both requests failed with:

> Browser control authentication was blocked because the local listener owner could not be verified.

No browser launch or Chrome attachment occurred. The intended Gemini test was never sent. This report contains no credentials, personal paths, account identifiers, or raw diagnostic logs.

## Investigation

The error is produced by BrowserProxyCapability before sending authentication to the local browser control service.

In the installed release's browserControlAuthorization callback, I found checks for an SSH-owned listener and an application-managed local WSL Gateway. I did not find a Native Gateway runtime ownership branch in that callback. The active configuration has a Native package/runtime contract, no SSH configuration, and no setup-managed WSL name.

This suggests a mismatch between the Native Gateway configuration and the ownership-validation path. It is a hypothesis, not a confirmed root cause: I have not determined which internal validation condition returns false.

## Expected behavior and request

Please confirm whether browser.proxy ownership validation is supported for this Native Gateway configuration in the current release, and whether there is a supported fix or configuration procedure.

The ownership check has not been disabled, and no authentication data or browser profiles have been copied. I am looking for a supported solution that preserves the security checks.

## References

- [BrowserProxyCapability in the installed release](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/v2026.9.8-1/src/OpenClaw.Shared/Capabilities/BrowserProxyCapability.cs#L73-L80)
- [Browser authorization callback in the installed release](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/v2026.9.8-1/src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/App.xaml.cs#L2220-L2254)
- [Gateway node browser routing](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.9.9/docs/tools/browser/remote.md#node-browser-proxy-zero-config-default)
